articles.headline: UEFA to boycott all FIFA competitions to protest World Cup private equity plan
articles.description: UEFA on Thursday voted to boycott all FIFA competitions in protest against FIFA president Gianni Infantino's plan for selling a stake in World Cup revenue to private investors.

articles.headline: Carlo Ancelotti: Tactical mistake during hydration break led to Brazil's World Cup exit
articles.description: Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti has blamed the tactical changes he made during the second-half hydration break against Norway for his team's early exit from the World Cup.

articles.headline: Australian players slam FIFA plan as Football Australia waits for more info
articles.description: Football Australia says it was unaware of FIFA's plans to sell stakes in tournaments such as the FIFA World Cup, but has confirmed it will not form a position until further information and consultation are provided.
